paragraphs.text: The Irencrag is a magical stone artifact on the plane of Eldraine . It is a massive boulder glowing with volcanic heat, located near The Burning Yard in Embereth . Its status after the fall of the Courts during the New Phyrexian Invasion is unknown.

The Irencrag was central to the knighting ritual of Embereth. An aspiring knight would plunged their sword into the Irencrag as a test of courage while the Irencrag itself spoke to them tauntingly; if the aspirant was held back by fear of the heat, they could not pull their sword out. According to legend, this ritual originated with the knight Ianthe, who impaled the Irencrag after it taunted her. When Irencrag finds a knight particularly worthy, it empowers their sword with a legendary name. This led to the creation of the Embercleave .

Originally, the Irencrag was created as the red relic for Throne of Eldraine , but the card design team wanted to make a sword instead of a stone (both for gameplay and to hit the “legendary sword” trope). Since the Irencrag was so important to Embereth, they decided to make the sword Embercleave connected to it. That’s how they decided the Irencrag could name a sword and turn it into a legendary weapon. It later received its own card in Wilds of Eldraine .
